hooks.name: Projen Generated File Guard
hooks.description: Prevents accidental edits to projen-generated files by checking for the generated marker before any write operation.

action.prompt: Before writing to this file, check if it contains the marker "~~ Generated by projen" or is listed in .projen/files.json. If it does, STOP and tell the user to modify .projenrc.ts instead and run "yarn projen" to regenerate. Do NOT write to projen-generated files.
